units: <cite ref="Yoma 22b:11">Yoma 22ᵇ</cite> <he>דאוריה ודה׳</he> the sin against Uriah and that of counting the people to which he was enticed (<cite ref="II Samuel 24:1">II Sam. XXIV, 1</cite>).
Ḥull. 4ᵇ אין ה׳ בדברים enticing (the verb הסית) never applies to verbal persuasion (but only to sensual influences).
Sifré Deut. 87 אין ה׳ אלא טעות enticing means leading astray; אין ה׳ אלא גירוי it means instigation.
